Subject: Initial MAP: Integration priorities and evaluation timeline

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the run-through on Tuesday. We've sketched a high-level MAP on our side and want to align on the integration workstreams and an evaluation plan. Key business goals: reduce average conversational latency to <300ms for triage flows, ensure PII redaction for notes, and validate tool-calling reliability for 3 downstream services.

High-level asks from ApexHealth:
- A short integration pilot targeting the triage SDK (text-in/text-out) with streaming enabled
- An auth review to confirm token rotation and KMS integration
- A set of automated evals for quality (50 prompts) + latency baselining

Can you confirm Redwood owners for SDK + streaming tests and an estimated timeline for a 2-week pilot? Attached is a draft MAP (Apex_MAP_v1.xlsx) — it has owners from our side.

Thanks,
Sara

-- 
Sara Lim
Head of Integrations
ApexHealth

Summary / owners (Redwood):
- SDK integration (Python + Node): Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.ai) — tasks: sample app, token sample, streaming example
- Auth & KMS review: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.ai) — tasks: token rotation flow, KMS policy mapping, audit log sample
- Streaming/tool-calling tests: Hannah Schmitt (hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai) — tasks: long-run stream stability, function call retries, server-sent events test harness
- Eval harness + prompt set: joint (Redwood + Apex) — proposed kickoff call next Tue to finalize prompts

Proposed timeline (2-week pilot):
- Week 0 (this week): align MAP + kickoff, exchange creds (staging), confirm test harness
- Week 1: SDK smoke tests, auth verification, baseline latency run (50 prompts)
- Week 2: Streaming load tests, tool-calling reliability, quality eval + final review

Action: can you confirm availability for a 30m kickoff on Monday 7/6 (PST)? If Monday is tight, Tue morning works.

Hannah

Looping in detailed task breakdown as discussed in today's prep. I pulled the items out of the Apex MAP and mapped owners, ETA, and acceptance criteria. Dropped the quick status for each.

1) SDK sample app (Python + Node) — owner: marcus_lin — ETA: 2026-07-10
   - Deliverable: two minimal examples (sync + streaming) and README for staging keys
   - Acceptance: sample handles stream reconnect + prints token expiry headers
   - Status: starting today (w/ local mock)

2) Auth review & token rotation flow — owner: laura_bennett — ETA: 2026-07-08
   - Deliverable: token rotation doc, KMS mapping, example audit log export
   - Acceptance: Apex security confirms rotation meets their policy (staging run)
   - Status: LAURA to request staging IAM policy from Apex

3) Streaming stability tests — owner: hannah_schmitt — ETA: 2026-07-15
   - Deliverable: 24h stability run, tool-calling under intermittent failures, SSE harness
   - Acceptance: <1% dropped frames, function calls retried successfully at least 3x
   - Status: designing harness; need staging endpoints + load generator from Apex

4) Eval harness + prompts (joint) — owner: marcus_lin (coord) — ETA: 2026-07-14
   - Deliverable: 50-prompt set, automated eval script, baseline latency/quality report
   - Acceptance: report delivered to Apex with pass/fail gates

Blocking items (from Apex): staging URLs, token for staging, confirmation on data retention for logs.

I'll push the task sheet to the shared Drive after this email. Please add any missing acceptance criteria.

Marcus
